text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Transcend carved an undeniable record into the sand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And perhaps due to those achievements—
I received a message from a most unexpected person."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh, a Dubai billionaire...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Wait, could that be from back then...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Marhaban!
Ismi Transcend!

text_block_list.name: Dubai Billionaire
text_block_list.text: Transcend...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure I put in a good word during the Leopard Stakes...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, sounds like she's quite the bigwig in the racing world now.
Yeah, apparently they're quite a big deal in the racing world now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The message received was an official invitation to Dubai,
starting with 'Do you remember me?'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: An invitation to the international GⅠ held in Dubai. It was an extraordinary honor.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Dubai's international GⅠ...! If we win, it'll be the best possible support for the reconstruction effort!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go! Of course I wanna go!!
No matter what it takes!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
B-But still... Dubai, huh.
The competition over there is suuuper tough, you know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "...No way that's possible, right? If I lose big and let the whole country down..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click, click, click...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Trainy?
Whatcha doing on your phone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I send a message to the LANE group.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa, this is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan!? Did you spill the beans to them?
Before we even decided what to do?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as expected, there was a whole chorus of
"Go for it!" and "Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...What a tactician. You've cut off all my exits.
When you place this much expectation on me...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta go!!
Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Riiiing!*)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Having said that,
I wonder if we can truly hold our own against them...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Representing the country...
That really is too heavy of a burden...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Transcend-chan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"There's no need to be so afraid.
You are not alone!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We're a team.
Right, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's treat this like a team battle this time!
Yeah, let's treat this like a team battle!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...
I see. The three of us are one.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You know that saying! One arrow breaks easily,
but three arrows won't break at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The goal this time is not individual victory.
This is, to a large extent, about representing
a nation that is still in the middle of reconstruction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"We must accomplish this, without fail.
The three of us, as one. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright, great start!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(The opponent is strong! And the strategy
Trainy gave me—is just one thing!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(Right, forward! Forward! Forward!
Just as my—curiosity demands!)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I've always moved forward and seized what I wanted!
That's why!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, a one-two finish!
They've done it! A miraculous one-two finish!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And the one who brilliantly crossed the finish line in 1st place was—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... Trai-chan.
I did it. But...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
I fell just a little short...
choice_data_list: No, you did great! Second place is practically a win!
No, you did great! Second place is as good as a win.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You think so...? Yeah... you're right...
We did it. On this grand stage in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"You were able to achieve this much.
There's nothing you can't do!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"If we managed to get that across to everyone
watching over us back home,
then there's no better loss than this."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with a 2nd-place finish, in terms of inspiring
her homeland, it was nothing short of a glorious victory.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
Please tell us your thoughts on your victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "As the victorious Umamusume answered the interviewers and sent cheers back to her homeland—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, Trainer-chan.
Let's just focus on doing what we need to do.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "I brought the latest gadget just for this occasion."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: And that is—tadaaa, this!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ‘Just a plain stick’!
choice_data_list: A stick!? What are you gonna do with that?
A stick!? What are you going to do with that?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'll send a message to everyone with this.
Not just to the people in the north...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"To all my friends around the world
who supported my relief work!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: We're gonna write it super big on the sands of Dubai! Here goes~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Transcend galloped across
the sand—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It's done! A message to everyone from me and Train-chan!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens, let's overcome it and keep going!
Reach everyone!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: HOPE！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout her racing career,
Transcend achieved numerous glories,
including back-to-back Champions Cup victories. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It etched something far more precious
and far deeper into the memories of that era.
